posts.post:
most guys buy gear for the activity they plan on doing. 

stop buying for the hobby and start buying for the reality of your day.

we finally settled on the final stitch count for the new collar. 

it took us six weeks and I still think I might be the only person who cares.
when you find a brand that finally gets the sleeve length right on a long sleeve, you never leave them.
buying a jacket with a hood that is actually big enough to stay on your head in the rain.
